chunks: From him, from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Muʿāwiyah ibn Ḥukaym, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥasan ibn Ribāṭ, from Ismāʿīl ibn Jābir, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about prayers that had accumulated upon me. He said: “Estimate carefully and make them up.”

key_terms.اقْضِهَا: make them up as qaḍāʾ, i.e. perform the missed prayers
key_terms.الصَّلَاةِ: salat (prayer), the obligatory ritual prayer being discussed
key_terms.تَجْتَمِعُ: accumulate or gather up, referring to multiple missed prayers
key_terms.تَحَرَّ: estimate carefully and seek the likely amount with diligence

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if they have many missed prayers and do not know their exact number?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding missed salat (prayer) that have accumulated. The Imam عليه السلام instructs the questioner to make a careful estimation and then perform their qada' to discharge the obligation.
